# Load Cellranger count

```{r,message=FALSE}
# Load 10x dataset
o <- DropletUtils::read10xCounts("../../apps/geo_download/downloads/GSE224407/GSM7021828_E19_raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5")

rownames(o) <- make.unique(mcols(o)$Symbol)
```

# Save object
